description: This file defines the `CouponDefinition` entity class, which models coupon configurations used in a promotions service within an e-commerce application. It includes properties such as coupon code, type (percentage or fixed amount), validity periods, and invariant validation logic. The class interacts with a database table `coupon_definition` in the `shopizer` schema, utilizing JPA annotations for persistence.

classes.name: CouponDefinition
classes.description: Entity class representing a coupon configuration with validation to ensure correspondence to business rules and invariants.

classes.name: CouponType
classes.description: Enum for differentiating coupon types: PERCENTAGE and FIXED_AMOUNT.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to normalize data and set creation/update timestamps before persisting.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to normalize data and update the timestamp before updating the entity.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Trims and converts code and currency fields to uppercase.

methods.name: validateInvariants
methods.description: Validates that the coupon's properties meet the business invariants based on the coupon type.

methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the coupon definition.

methods.name: getPercentageOff
methods.description: Returns the percentage discount value for percentage coupons.

methods.description: Sets the percentage discount value.

methods.name: getEndsAt

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
